About Obby: Lucky Block Heist

Build the ultimate base in this action-packed 3D Obby! Collect rare Brainrot items to generate passive income and grow your empire. Want the best loot? Sneak into heavily guarded zones to steal legendary Lucky Blocks! But beware: if the patrolling enemies catch you, youll be blasted back! Upgrade your speed and jump height to outmaneuver guards, and use the rebirth system to unlock insane multi-jumps. Can you steal the rarest blocks, max out your stats, and become the richest player?
